source.title: Unicom 141 Series Calculator Operating Instructions
source.extraction: Operation tables visually checked against the scanned PDF; decimal strings preserve printed precision.

coverage_notes: All 42 numbered operation examples are included.
Sections 12 and 13 state buffer and entry capacity but provide no numbered operation example.
Setup keys are harness isolation, separate from the printed manual steps.
Expected tape entries are an ordered suffix of the newly printed rows at each checkpoint; not every intermediate row is asserted.
FL examples without a specified DP use DP=2 (or 0 for integers) as an explicit harness choice.
Square-root examples require the feature present in this recovered five-ROM image; other firmware variants must not claim full coverage.
